[Benzinga news, 2026-10-26T11:31:58Z, by staff] Verizon Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
Verizon announced strong third-quarter 2026 financial results, highlighted by significant postpaid phone net additions and account growth, while raising its full-year outlook for net additions and adjusted earnings per share.
Verizon reported its third-quarter 2026 results, achieving its strongest postpaid phone net additions in five years and its best quarterly net account growth in over a decade. The company also reported lower year-over-year churn, attributing the performance to its ongoing multi-year transformation strategy. Reflecting this momentum, Verizon increased its full-year forecast for postpaid phone net additions to a range of 1.1 million to 1.2 million, up from its previous outlook. Additionally, the company now expects adjusted earnings per share to grow by 7% to 7.5% for the full year.
